title: fix(cloud-connection): unmanaged install-local writes the log line its fallback names, at any status
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8Bjniy1KUKzykb69Rgkafke)_
Fixes #29822

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` 的 unmanaged 分支,导入被拒时,只要回答用的是兜底句「the reason is in the server log」,就写那条 `warn` 日志,不再只在 5xx 时写;能原样带回原因的拒绝不写。状态码、错误码、响应形状都不变。
- 为什么改:用 `statusCode` 或校验形状(无数字 `status`)声明 4xx 的拒绝,消息不会回给客户端,回答却让运维去看日志,而日志里什么都没有(#29342 的 dev 经 HTTP 门实测:400、无日志)。
- 风险与回滚:只多写一条 `warn`,不改任何对外字段;回滚即还原一个 commit。
- 先看:`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` 的 unmanaged catch(`message === fallback` 那一行),其次 `marketplace-install-local-install-modes.test.ts` 新增的三个用例。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/marketplace-install-local-install-modes.test.ts`,预期 26/26 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The unmanaged branch of `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` catches the import's throw and answers `clientFacingFailureText(err, fallback)`, where the fallback says "the reason is in the server log". It used to write that log line only when the throw resolved to 5xx. `clientFacingFailureText` quotes a message only when the throw declared a numeric 4xx `status`, so a 4xx this door resolves through `statusCode` or the validation shape got the fallback and no log line.

Now there is one rule at every status: the door computes the answer first, and writes the `warn` line exactly when the answer is the fallback sentence. The fallback sentence is spelled once. The log line also names the resolved status and code. A refusal whose reason reaches the body writes no line, as before.

## Why

The operator who moves a package between environments with `os package install --unmanaged` or the Console was told where the reason is, and the reason was not there.

## Tests

`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-install-modes.test.ts`, beside the existing 5xx case:

- Two cases, a 4xx declared by `statusCode: 409` and one declared by the validation shape: the body carries the reason, or the `warn` log carries the import's message.
- One control: a refusal with a numeric 409 `status` is quoted in the body and writes no log line.

Ablation (fix committed first at 4ac62487, mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, `if (message === fallback) {` back to `if (resolved.status >= 500) {`, anchor 1 → 0, blob `ec8cba1e` → `1a44e3bf`): both 4xx cases go red (`expected '[MarketplaceInstallLocal] [protocol] …' to contain 'Record is locked by approval apv_7'`, and the same for the validation sentence), 2 failed / 24 passed. Restored: `git diff HEAD` empty, blob back to `ec8cba1e` = the HEAD blob. The test imports the plugin from `src` by a relative path, so no `dist/` leg is involved.

## Acceptance notes

How the other doors that use a "reason is in the server log" fallback pair it with a log line, read on `origin/main` 42ff86f6:

- `protocol.ts` `migrateStoredMetadata` and the publish side-effects collector, `protocol-publish-backfill.ts`, and `runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` `applyPublishedSeeds` log unconditionally beside the fallback, at any status.
- Batch rows (`toRowApiError` → `clientFacingRowFailureText`) and the external-driver read floor (`external-driver-floor.ts` `readRefusal`) log at the point they withhold, which is the rule this PR applies.
- `seed-loader.ts` logs the cause beside each withheld row through its `seedCauseLabel` lines.
- `packagePersistFailureError` always answers 5xx, so the boundary logs it.

No exported helper couples "fallback text ⇔ log line" today. The batch-row one is private to `metadata-protocol`, so this door applies the rule inline. No other door showed the same 4xx gap.
